sources.title: Detailed Penis - v1.0 | Krea 2 LoRA | Civitai
sources.snippet: The trigger word is P3n15, but I have found that is not needed... This LoRA generates a detailed penis. It works with character LoRAs. All samples images were generated with Krea 2 Turbo FP8 Scaled model using er_sde sampler and simple scheduler.

sources.title: AIroticArt's Penis Model (LoRA) v1.0 LoRA for SD 1.5 | CivArchive
sources.snippet: Update 4/2/23: For more examples, we used this LoRA to help create the penises in our art, The Beauty of Couples, Collection #14. This is a LoRA version of our Penis Model. It was extracted from the regular v1.0 of that model (we don't think it is possible to extract LoRAs from inpainting models). This LoRA still does best as an "inpainting model," when used in inpainting mode to fix penis ...
